annotations.title: Search EU and national law in one call

description: One query run as semantic searches over EU legislation, EU case law and the legislation and case law of chosen live countries, returned as one list. Each hit names its jurisdiction and kind and keeps its identifiers; a national hit keeps its attribution, which must be kept with republished content (Terms). Legislation hits carry inForce ("unknown" when no status is reported); an EU case-law hit has none, and a national decision carries inForce: false once its recorded end of validity has passed. sources lists every search as ok, failed or not_run with the reason (country not live, plan, national allowance, rate limit, credits): a search that did not run is not shown as empty, and none starts once credits or the rate limit run out. Scores come from separate indexes, so the order across sources is approximate. Cost: 5 credits per search; searches = jurisdictions × kinds: 2 by default, at most 16 (80 credits). Each national search also counts against the national-law allowance. For filters, asOf, hyde or paging use the single-index search tools.

jurisdictions.description: Where to search: "eu" and/or national codes, e.g. ["eu","at","de"] (default ["eu"]; at most 8, "eu" included; each adds up to 10 credits).

kinds.description: What to search in each jurisdiction (default both).

language.description: Preferred language of EU texts (default en); a national search uses the country's own language.

limit.description: Max hits per search (plan caps as on the semantic tools).

query.description: Natural-language description of the provision or legal issue.
